# The declarations that TestSketchBuildsSayWhy admits: each builds Go (buildAll,
# ergoCLI, or the go command) with no "builds Go because" line in its doc
# comment. A row is `path<TAB>function<TAB>reason`; a row that admits nothing
# fails the test. Each row names the unit that removes it; none is added: a
# new test that builds Go says why in its doc comment (AGENTS.md, Tests).
